body: City noise from traffic and building works can raise stress and harm our sleep.
交通和施工的噪音会让人更紧张，还会影响睡眠。
Some cities now use quieter road surfaces and noise-reducing windows to cut sound.
一些城市开始用更安静的路面、隔音窗来降低声音。
The BBC discussion asks whether a calmer soundscape can make people happier.
BBC这期讨论：更安静的声音环境，会不会让人更幸福。
Ultra-processed food is made with industrial ingredients and often contains added sugar and fat.
超加工食品用工业原料做成，常含额外糖分和脂肪。
Studies link eating a lot of it with health problems like heart disease and weight gain.
研究显示，吃太多这类食品与心脏病、长胖等健康问题有关。
The programme suggests cooking simple meals at home as an easy way to eat less of it.
节目建议：在家做简单饭菜，是少吃超加工食品的轻松办法。
Many people dislike certain foods, but taste can change as we grow older.
很多人讨厌某些食物，但随着年龄增长，口味会改变。
BBC speakers share how they learned to enjoy foods they once hated, like olives or cheese.
BBC嘉宾分享：他们如何慢慢爱上曾经讨厌的食物，比如橄榄或奶酪。
Trying a food many times in different ways can turn dislike into a new favourite.
用不同做法多试几次，讨厌的食物也可能变成新宠。

articles.en: Searching for life on another planet
body: Scientists look for signs of life on planets far away, such as unusual gases in the air.
科学家在遥远的星球上寻找生命迹象，比如空气中不寻常的气体。
Special telescopes study light from these planets to learn what they are made of.
特殊望远镜研究这些星球发出的光，判断它们由什么构成。
The BBC programme explores whether we might one day find tiny life beyond Earth.
BBC节目探讨：未来我们是否会在地球之外发现微小生命。
Where our food comes from is changing, with labs growing meat and farms using smart sensors.
食物的来源正在改变：实验室培育肉、农场用上智能传感器。
The episode discusses whether these new methods can feed more people with less harm to the planet.
这一期讨论：这些新方法能否用更少的地球伤害养活更多人。
Listeners hear both hope and doubt about what our dinner plates will look like in 20 years.
听众听到对20年后餐桌模样的期待，也有疑虑。
